title: Record filing an absence without saying what kind it is
summary: Declares an unmeasured dimension but states no reasonKind, so the absence reads the same whether nobody got round to measuring it or a body declined to keep the record.
caseFor: Present so the record fails on the missing reasonKind alone, not on a missing case.

unmeasured.what: A dimension with no reason kind attached
unmeasured.why: States why in prose but does not classify it, which is what the rule requires.
unmeasured.wouldFill: A source that would close it
